project.title: Launch of Data-Driven Feedback Hub for New Products
project.objective: Design and pilot a central feedback hub that consolidates sales, user feedback, and market insights to improve product launch decisions.
deliverables: Defined product vision and success metrics for the feedback hub MVP
User journey map and low-fidelity UX prototype of the hub
Requirements specification and data model for feedback aggregation
Pilot rollout plan with target segments and communication strategy
Training materials and playbook for internal users of the hub
Post-pilot performance and insights report with next-step recommendations
constraints: MVP scope must be locked within 2 weeks to meet launch date
Use only existing internal data sources and tools for the pilot
Comply with internal data privacy and access control policies
Limit pilot to one region and two product lines
All documentation must be understandable by non-technical stakeholders

risks.risk: Scope creep due to adding too many feedback sources into the MVP.
risks.mitigation: Define and sign off on MVP scope and non-goals; track changes via a single backlog and require approval from product manager.

risks.risk: Low adoption of the hub by sales and support teams during the pilot.
risks.mitigation: Co-create workflows with key users, run short training sessions, and define simple usage KPIs for the pilot period.

risks.risk: Data quality issues leading to misleading insights in the hub.
risks.mitigation: Business analysts validate data sources, define quality checks, and flag limitations clearly in documentation and dashboards.

risks.risk: Misalignment between product, marketing, and sales on how to act on feedback.
risks.mitigation: Set up recurring alignment check-ins and a shared decision log for prioritizing feedback-driven changes.

risks.risk: Tight timeline causing incomplete documentation and training materials.
risks.mitigation: Prioritize lightweight but clear templates, and schedule documentation as explicit tasks in the backlog with owners.

themes.why_relevant: Keeps the feedback hub focused on high-impact features and avoids delays from scope creep.
Determines which feedback signals are reliable enough to drive product decisions.
Ensures sales and support teams can quickly find and act on feedback insights.
Product, sales, and marketing must agree on how to interpret and use feedback data.
Internal users need clear guidance to adopt the hub in their daily workflows.
Defines how success is measured and what to improve before broader rollout.

backlog.task: Define product vision, target users, and success metrics for the feedback hub MVP
definition_of_done: Vision statement and problem framing documented in shared doc
Primary internal user personas and use cases described
3–5 measurable success metrics agreed with stakeholders
Stakeholders review and sign off on the vision and metrics

backlog.task: Map current feedback flows from sales, support, and marketing into a single process view
definition_of_done: As-is process diagram created covering all key feedback channels
Pain points and duplication in current flows identified
Data owners and systems of record listed
Validated with at least two stakeholder groups

backlog.task: Design user journeys and low-fidelity UX prototype for the feedback hub
definition_of_done: Key user journeys documented for sales and support personas
Low-fidelity wireframes created for main screens
At least three users review prototype and provide feedback
Iteration notes captured and prototype updated once

backlog.task: Define data model and requirements for aggregating feedback signals
definition_of_done: List of required data fields and sources documented
Data mapping and transformation rules drafted
Constraints and known data quality issues captured
Requirements reviewed with product manager and data owner

backlog.task: Create pilot rollout plan including scope, timeline, and communication strategy
definition_of_done: Pilot objectives, scope, and target user groups defined
Timeline with key milestones and responsibilities created
Communication plan for launch and updates documented
Plan shared and approved by core stakeholders

backlog.task: Develop training materials and quick-start guide for internal users
definition_of_done: Short slide deck explaining purpose and workflows created
Step-by-step quick-start guide drafted with screenshots or mockups
FAQ section with at least 10 anticipated questions added
Materials piloted with 2–3 users and refined based on feedback

backlog.task: Define governance for feedback triage and prioritization
definition_of_done: Roles and responsibilities for triage documented
Prioritization criteria and scoring model defined
Cadence for review meetings agreed
Governance shared with product and sales stakeholders

backlog.task: Align marketing and sales on how to use insights from the hub in campaigns
definition_of_done: Workshop agenda and materials prepared
Joint session held with marketing and sales representatives
List of agreed use cases for insights documented
Follow-up actions and owners captured in a summary

backlog.task: Design and schedule internal enablement sessions for pilot participants
definition_of_done: Session objectives and format defined
Calendar invites sent to all pilot participants
Interactive exercises or demos prepared
Feedback form for participants created

backlog.task: Define pilot measurement framework and reporting cadence
definition_of_done: KPIs and data sources for pilot performance listed
Reporting templates for weekly updates created
Ownership for data collection assigned
Measurement plan validated with product manager

backlog.task: Consolidate pilot learnings and propose next-phase roadmap
definition_of_done: Usage and feedback data from pilot synthesized
Key wins, issues, and improvement areas summarized
High-level roadmap options for next phase drafted
Roadmap discussed and refined with core team

backlog.task: Create concise reference guide on data privacy and acceptable use for the hub
definition_of_done: Key privacy rules and constraints summarized in plain language
Examples of acceptable and non-acceptable use cases listed
Guide reviewed by a compliance or data owner representative
Guide linked from all training and onboarding materials

threads_plan.thread_goal: Align on MVP vision, target users, and success metrics for the feedback hub.
threads_plan.trigger: Kickoff message announcing the project and requesting feedback on the draft vision doc.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Approve the MVP vision statement and primary user personas.
Agree on the initial set of 3–5 success metrics for the pilot.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Lock MVP scope by agreeing on data sources and core workflows.
threads_plan.trigger: Business analyst shares mapped feedback flows and proposed MVP scope for review.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Select which feedback channels and data sources are in scope for the MVP.
Confirm the core user workflows that must be supported in the first release.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Review and iterate on user journeys, UX wireframes, and training approach.
threads_plan.trigger: Product manager posts initial wireframes and assistant lecturer shares training outline.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Approve the UX for main user journeys for the pilot.
Agree on the training format and key topics for pilot participants.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Finalize pilot rollout plan, measurement framework, and governance.
threads_plan.trigger: Product manager shares draft rollout plan and business analyst posts KPI tracker.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Confirm pilot scope, target groups, and rollout timeline.
Agree on KPIs, reporting cadence, and triage governance for the pilot.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Synthesize pilot results and align on next-phase roadmap.
threads_plan.trigger: End-of-pilot message sharing summary of usage, feedback, and draft roadmap.

channel_rituals: Daily async standup where each core member posts yesterday/today/blockers in one thread.
Twice-weekly scope and risk check-in to review changes, dependencies, and open decisions.
Weekly pilot readiness or adoption review using the KPI tracker sheet.
Post-training feedback thread after each enablement session to capture improvements.
End-of-pilot retrospective thread to document learnings and confirm roadmap decisions.
